ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume hashlib RIPEMD-160 implementation is reliable and any failures would result in EVM execution error.

implicit_assumptions.description: The RIPEMD-160 precompile is always available at address 0x03 on mainnet and compatible chains
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Contracts using RIPEMD-160 for Bitcoin address compatibility could fail

implicit_assumptions.description: The hashlib RIPEMD-160 implementation produces cryptographically correct hashes
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Hash collisions or incorrect hashes could compromise Bitcoin-Ethereum bridge contracts

implicit_assumptions.description: Output is always exactly 32 bytes with consistent left-padding format
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Contracts expecting specific output format could misinterpret hash values

implicit_assumptions.description: Finding RIPEMD-160 collisions is computationally infeasible given current cryptographic understanding
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Collision attacks could compromise contracts relying on RIPEMD-160 for unique identifiers

implicit_assumptions.description: Empty input (0 bytes) produces the hash of empty string, not an error
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Contracts hashing potentially empty data could encounter unexpected behavior
